subject: literacy
concept: Basic self-editing: checking your own writing for capital letters, punctuation, and spelling of known words
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student uses a simple checklist (capital? punctuation? spelling?) to review a sample piece of writing
exercise.pictorial: Student circles the errors in a sample sentence using the same checklist
exercise.abstract: Student reviews and corrects their own previously written piece using the checklist independently

assessment.mastery_threshold: catches at least 3 of 4 planted errors in a sample using the checklist
misconception_flags: reviews for one error type only (e.g. spelling) while ignoring the others on the checklist

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
